title: Trump Signs Rural Broadband Protection Act Into Law, Strengthening FCC Vetting of USF Applicants
detail: President Trump signed the Rural Broadband Protection Act (S.98) into law on May 11, 2026. The bipartisan bill — sponsored by Senators Capito (R-WV), Klobuchar (D-MN), and Curtis (R-UT) — requires the FCC to conduct enhanced financial vetting of ISP applicants before committing Universal Service Fund (USF) high-cost program dollars, including minimum financial penalties for pre-funding default. The legislation was designed to prevent fraud in rural broadband subsidy programs following several high-profile cases where ISPs received federal subsidies but failed to deploy services. The act strengthens accountability in the $8 billion-per-year Universal Service Fund and applies to all future high-cost rural broadband disbursements, including BEAD program allocations channeled through the USF. Senators framed the law as essential to ensuring public investment in rural connectivity actually reaches underserved communities.

title: Orange Announces Training 3 Million Young Africans in AI and Cybersecurity at Africa Forward Summit Opening
detail: At the opening of the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi on May 11, 2026, Orange (France's largest telecom operator) announced major expanded commitments for Africa and the Middle East: training more than 3 million young Africans in AI, cybersecurity, and digital skills by 2030, and expanding its Orange Digital Centers from 50 to 100 locations across Africa and the Middle East. The announcement came as France and African leaders convened for the two-day summit focused on economic partnership and digital transformation. Orange's 3-million-youth training target addresses a critical skills pillar of digital inclusion — the GSMA's Mobile Economy 2026 data shows Africa's 63% mobile internet usage gap is driven primarily by digital skills deficits rather than infrastructure absence. The Orange Digital Centers serve as free digital training hubs with coding programs, entrepreneurship support, and device access for unemployed youth.
